'''Galway''' was an [[Agent/Legends|Imperial Special Agent]]. He was in charge of intervening in illegal enslavement in accordance to Imperial Law. Idealistic, he did not consider the hypocrisy of the slavery the Empire itself was involved in. He was injured while investigating rumors of slave traders.<ref name="FH">''[[Far Horizons]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Galway appeared in the role-playing sourcebook ''[[Far Horizons]]'' released in [[2014]] and developed by [[Sam Stewart]].<ref name="FH">''[[Far Horizons]]''</ref>
